blurb: Park Tavern is a historic venue originally built in 1905, now hosting weddings, corporate events, private parties, and festivals. It features multiple event spaces including the Piedmont Room, Piedmont Garden Tent, Ski Lodge, Tavern Lounge, and Enclosed Patio. The venue offers full restaurant amenities and a seasonal ice skating rink.
